I need to recall property law concepts here. Community property typically applies to married couples, so if the will says "community property" but they're siblings, that might not apply. So the default might be tenancy in common unless specified otherwise.

The co-worker doesn't have a right of survivorship unless it's a joint tenancy. The will didn't mention joint tenancy, so it's likely tenancy in common.
